scope: Read-only review of four frozen PR494 files and nine included dependency sources; no imports, product/test execution, API export, source write or ref mutation.

findings.finding: The two public builders retain their readingSummaries parameters but no longer derive competence, deficits, problem words or practice priority from ASR summaries. Existing reading-summary storage is not changed or migrated.

Existing SkillRecord mastery and weaknessScore use assessed independent evidence. The unchanged subject helper and supplied skill records still support positive reading strength and assessed-error practice; the new tests expressly retain these cases.

Both adapter read paths await a successful platform reload immediately before getString. Failed reload propagates rather than acknowledging the optimistic Dart cache; all write implementations and profile-owned key construction remain byte-identical.

The unchanged controller serializes by owner, checks its captured profile guard around reads/writes, compares persisted round content/revision, and reuses the owner-plus-round result identity when settling an uncertain reward. The new adapter does not bypass these paths.

The two complete new test files retain real adapter/controller and SharedPreferences caching behavior with a controlled platform backend; cases distinguish rejected writes from committed writes with lost replies, failed reloads, revoked ownership and old-owner in-flight writes. Reading cases distinguish observations from independent assessed records and preserve old serialized summaries.

The frozen source list has exactly two changed production files and two new tests; no workflow, pins, lockfile, C4/Village probe, writer, journal or InkSurface file is included. Reference package constraints and exact lockfile bytes are bound separately; no dependency installation was requested.

boundaries: This independent review did not rerun the producer or current candidate tests and does not certify Android, rendering, audio or performance.
